_howToAdd: Add a tool by copying one object into 'toolbox' (tools that match a book chapter) or 'workshop' (Henry's wider body of work). status: live | in-progress | retired. A retired tool keeps its entry but its url must be null so the page never sends readers to it. Every url must be checked in a browser before it goes in. Never use a lovable.app or Bitly address; use skoo.ly or the tool's own domain.

toolbox.name: Sourdough ↔ Yeast Recipe Converter
toolbox.what: Converts a recipe from commercial yeast to sourdough, or back again.
toolbox.problem: Swapping yeast for starter isn't a one-for-one trade. Your starter brings its own flour and water, and the converter counts them so the dough comes out right.
toolbox.forWho: Bakers who want to make a favorite yeasted recipe with their starter.

toolbox.name: The Fermentation Compass
toolbox.what: Helps you decide between a counter ferment and a cold ferment for the time you have.
toolbox.problem: Counter or fridge is the question I hear most. The Compass walks you to an answer that fits your kitchen and your day.
toolbox.forWho: Anyone planning a bake around work, school or sleep.

toolbox.name: Starter & Levain Studio
toolbox.what: A starter and levain calculator: feeding ratios, levain builds and timing.
toolbox.problem: Getting a levain to peak right when the dough needs it takes math most of us don't want to do at 6 AM.
toolbox.forWho: New starter keepers and bakers building a levain for a recipe.

toolbox.name: The Sourdough Starter Guide
toolbox.what: My step-by-step guide to making a starter and keeping it healthy.
toolbox.problem: Most starters that "die" are just hungry or cold. The guide shows you what's normal so you don't throw a good one out.
toolbox.forWho: Day-one starter makers and anyone whose starter is acting up.

toolbox.name: Salt Converter
toolbox.what: Converts between table salt, kosher salt and other salts by weight and volume.
toolbox.problem: Not all salt weighs the same. A teaspoon of one brand can be nearly double another, and that's enough to wreck a loaf.
toolbox.forWho: Bakers measuring by volume or switching salt brands.

toolbox.name: Crust & Crumb Interactive Bread Baking Glossary
toolbox.what: 280 bread terms with plain definitions, pronunciations, common mistakes and guided learning paths. Free.
toolbox.problem: Bread has its own language. When the book says bassinage or fermentolyse, you can look it up and hear how it's said.
toolbox.forWho: Every reader. It backs the glossary at the end of the book.

toolbox.name: The Bread Authority
toolbox.what: My library of videos, articles, recipes and lessons, organized into 29 topics across 8 categories.
toolbox.problem: Years of videos and posts are no help if you can't find them. The Bread Authority puts each one under the topic it teaches.
toolbox.forWho: Bakers who want to go deeper on a chapter or fix a specific problem.

toolbox.name: Recipe Pantry
toolbox.what: The recipe collection behind the book's recipe QR codes, with scaling and printing.
toolbox.problem: A printed recipe can't scale itself or get better. Recipe Pantry can, and the book's recipe codes point there.
toolbox.forWho: Anyone baking the recipes in Parts 3 and 4.

toolbox.name: The Mill
toolbox.what: A fresh-milled flour planner from Recipe Pantry.
toolbox.problem: Fresh flour drinks more water and moves faster than bagged flour. The Mill helps you plan for that before you mix.
toolbox.forWho: Home millers and bakers new to fresh-milled flour.

toolbox.name: Ancient Grain Guide
toolbox.what: Helps fresh-milled bakers pick a flour blend and understand how an ancient grain handles.
toolbox.problem: Einkorn, spelt and emmer don't behave like modern wheat. The guide grew out of my ancient grain cheat sheets.
toolbox.forWho: Bakers working with einkorn, spelt, emmer or khorasan.

workshop.name: Bread Dough Calculator
workshop.what: Hydration, baker's percentages and recipe scaling in one place.

workshop.name: The Ancient Grain Challenge
workshop.what: Lessons and quizzes that take you from wheat berries to bread.

workshop.name: The Holiday Bake
workshop.what: My free holiday baking guide with recipes and a make-ahead calendar.

workshop.name: Recipe Pantry Pro
workshop.what: A recipe workspace for bakers who sell at markets: costing and scaling.

workshop.name: All Tools & Challenges
workshop.what: Every calculator, guide, quiz and challenge on BakingGreatBread.com in one list.

workshop.name: Original Sourdough ↔ Yeast Converter
workshop.what: My first converter. Replaced in October 2026 by the rebuilt converter in the toolbox above.
